outcome: Low back pain during and after pregnancy
cohort: The study included 50 women who had undergone surgery for Adolescent Idiopathic Scoliosis between 1984 and 2014, leading to a total of 80 pregnancies reviewed from 1988 to 2018.
finding: Women who undergo spinal fusion for AIS typically experience normal pregnancies with vaginal deliveries, although access to effective epidural anesthesia appears to be problematic.
mod_finding: Of the 80 pregnancies, 81% were delivered by vaginal route, and the c-section rate (19%) was similar to the general population, with the level of fusion correlated with the c-section rate.
